expected_behavior: `fslc mutate` must fail closed when the external JSONL supplied with `--from` cannot be read, returning an `io` error envelope and exit code 2 rather than reporting an error with exit code 0.
spec_queries: fslc mutate --from missing file exit code
test_patch:
diff --git a/rust/fslc/tests/reviewgraphen_generated_calibration_12.rs b/rust/fslc/tests/reviewgraphen_generated_calibration_12.rs
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/rust/fslc/tests/reviewgraphen_generated_calibration_12.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+use std::path::Path;
+use std::process::Command;
+
+use serde_json::Value;
+
+#[test]
+fn reviewgraphen_generated_regression() {
+    let root = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"))
+        .parent()
+        .and_then(Path::parent)
+        .expect("repository root");
+
+    let missing = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
+        "fslc-reviewgraphen-missing-{}-{:?}.jsonl",
+        std::process::id(),
+        std::thread::current().id()
+    ));
+    assert!(!missing.exists(), "test path unexpectedly exists");
+
+    let output = Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_fslc"))
+        .args([
+            "mutate",
+            "tests/fixtures/rust_port/ai_review_conservation.fsl",
+            "--max-mutants",
+            "0",
+            "--from",
+            missing.to_str().expect("UTF-8 temporary path"),
+        ])
+        .current_dir(root)
+        .output()
+        .expect("run native fslc");
+
+    assert_eq!(
+        output.status.code(),
+        Some(2),
+        "stdout: {}; stderr: {}",
+        String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout),
+        String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
+    );
+    let value: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&output.stdout).expect("JSON error envelope");
+    assert_eq!(value["result"], "error");
+    assert_eq!(value["kind"], "io");
+}
